theme: Light Theme Default (Warm Kraft Sand & Deep Charcoal)

paperbag_artwork_requirement.rule: CRITICAL: NO FACES ON PAPERBAGS. All paperbag illustrations, hero photos, icons, and SVG components must be plain kraft paper bag graphics with NO facial features (no eyes, mouth, blush, or smile).
paperbag_artwork_requirement.component_update: BagArt component must render face={false} strictly. Hero image must use a clean, plain kraft paper bag image.

home_page_sections.hero: Main headline 'BIG IDEAS. FULL BAGS.' with plain paperbag hero visual and floating status badges.
home_page_sections.stats_overview: Live/simulated token metrics (tokens, volume, bags opened).
home_page_sections.token_grid: Featured token cards with search, filter tabs, and quick trade link.

bag_worker_explanatory_section.title: MEET THE BAG WORKER
bag_worker_explanatory_section.copy: Automated ecosystem engine that puts platform revenue to work for active tokens. Realized profits fill project bags.

global_bag_explanatory_section.title: THE GLOBAL BAG VAULTS
global_bag_explanatory_section.copy: Shared community vaults holding SOL, USDC, DOGE, and BONK funded by every launch, distributed to $PAPERBAG holders every 24 hours.

home_page_sections.launch_cta: Call to action banner to draft or launch a token.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, forms, and cards MUST include data-testid attributes.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.headers_and_nav: Site header MUST use backdrop-blur-md bg-[#faf7ed]/90 with border-b border-[#e8e0cc]. NEVER use fully transparent background on overlays, modals, or dropdown menus.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.spacing: Maintain generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) and gaps (gap-6, gap-8) across containers to ensure legibility and clean mobile layouts.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.mobile_responsiveness: Ensure grid-cols-1 on mobile scaling smoothly to grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-3 on desktop.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.animations: Micro-interactions with framer-motion for smooth hover states, status transitions, and progress fill bars.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace facial paperbag artwork with plain paperbag assets (face={false} on BagArt component, replace hero photo with plain paperbag URL).
2. Rename 'Carry' terminology to 'Bag Worker' across all UI labels, copy, buttons, navigation links, and subheaders.
3. Implement independent pages for /bag-worker and /global-bag in App.js router and page definitions.
4. On the Home page (/), add clean explanatory sections for 'Bag Worker' and 'Global Bag' linking directly to /bag-worker and /global-bag.
5. Tidy up messy page layouts: improve header alignment, balance card paddings, fix text overlaps, ensure clean responsive mobile views.
6. Ensure all test IDs specified in test files (site-header, brand-home, nav-*, hero-*, wallet-dialog, etc.) are strictly preserved.
